At the current stage, the library has 640 genes with various expression levels, CRISPR scores, and copy numbers.
downloaded predicted and selected grnas from Sanjana lab gitlab page https://gitlab.com/sanjanalab/cas13/-/blob/c864b4f267e22e0ef1a9f28651744f6d04d58eaf/TranscriptomeWidePredictions/results/gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs.txt 

gRNA data are also downloaded from batch download option of <https://cas13design.nygenome.org/> and selected transcripts are filtered out of the designed grnas and combined into a single file

On top of 31 lung cancer-related genes.
 
we include also 122 cancer related lncRNAs (from paper published in Nature Communications Biology doi: 10.1038/s42003-019-0741-7)
Sajita lab human cas13 gRNA list is a good source to pick already designed gRNAs. We can pick 2 guides targeting each UTR and 3 guides targeting the gene body (6 guides/transcript).
Pick 20 essential and 20 non-essential genes with various lengths to tile along the gene body.




```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library("here")
set.seed(125)
```
#mRNA guides selection
##picking gRNAs targeting mRNAs from all_mRNA Guides.csv, because rather than top 10 it reports wide range of gRNAs. (top 10 gRNAs generally cluster in very limited region)
```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}

final_selected_transcript_data<- read_delim(here(file="sym_101_design/output/final_selected_transcript_data.csv"))
gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs <- read.delim(here(file="sym_101_design/input/gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs.txt"))
gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs$Transcript_ID <- substring(gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs$ENST, 1, 15)
gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs$ensembl_gene_id <- substring(gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs$ENSG, 1, 15)
all_mRNA_data<- read_csv(here(file="sym_101_design/input/all_mRNA_guides.csv"))
final_gene_list<- read_csv(here(file="sym_101_design/output/final_gene_list_2025-04-23.csv"))





p<- gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs %>% filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% final_selected_transcript_data$ensembl_gene_id)
r<- gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs %>% filter(Transcript_ID %in% final_selected_transcript_data$Transcript_ID)
print(paste("I have",length(unique(p$Symbol)),"/", length(final_gene_list$Gene),"of target genes in designed gRNAs list. I selected",length(unique(final_selected_transcript_data$Transcript_ID)),"transcripts, but only",length(unique(r$Symbol)), "of them have already designed gRNAs"))
```

#pick grnas for the transcripts we have grna designed already

```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}

all_gRNA_data<- gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs%>% dplyr::select(6:42) %>% melt(id.vars = c("Transcript_ID","ensembl_gene_id","Symbol", "Length", "UTR5","CDS","UTR3"))

all_gRNA_data <- all_gRNA_data %>% separate(value, sep = "_", into = c("crRNA", "Seq", "Guide_Score","X"))
all_gRNA_data<- all_gRNA_data %>% separate(variable, sep = "_", into = c("Region","Type", "Number"))
all_gRNA_data<- all_gRNA_data%>% filter(!is.na(Guide_Score)) %>% droplevels()
all_gRNA_data$crna_2<- all_gRNA_data$crRNA
all_gRNA_data<- all_gRNA_data %>% separate(crna_2, into = c("cRNA_name", "start", "end"))
all_gRNA_data$start<- as.numeric(as.character(all_gRNA_data$start))

#annotate targeting region of each gRNA

transcript_coordinates<- all_gRNA_data %>% dplyr::select(1,UTR5, CDS, UTR3) %>% unique()
transcript_coordinates<- transcript_coordinates %>% separate(UTR5, into = c("UTR5_start", "UTR5_end")) %>% separate(CDS, into = c("CDS_start", "CDS_end")) %>% separate(UTR3, into = c("UTR3_start", "UTR3_end"))
all_mRNA_data<- left_join(all_mRNA_data, transcript_coordinates, by="Transcript_ID")
summary(all_mRNA_data)
all_mRNA_data$UTR5_start<- as.numeric(as.character(all_mRNA_data$UTR5_start))
all_mRNA_data$UTR5_end<- as.numeric(as.character(all_mRNA_data$UTR5_end))
all_mRNA_data$CDS_start<- as.numeric(as.character(all_mRNA_data$CDS_start))
all_mRNA_data$CDS_end<- as.numeric(as.character(all_mRNA_data$CDS_end))
all_mRNA_data$UTR3_start<- as.numeric(as.character(all_mRNA_data$UTR3_start))
all_mRNA_data$UTR3_end<- as.numeric(as.character(all_mRNA_data$UTR3_end))


all_mRNA_data<- all_mRNA_data %>% mutate(Region=case_when(
  MatchPos>UTR3_start ~ "UTR3",
  MatchPos>CDS_start ~ "CDS",
  MatchPos>UTR5_start ~ "UTR5"
  ))


# select high quality transcripts
all_mRNA_data<- all_mRNA_data %>% filter(quartiles==4 & (`mapped0e:mapped1e:mapped2e`=="0:0:0"|`mapped0e:mapped1e:mapped2e`=="0:0:1"|`mapped0e:mapped1e:mapped2e`=="0:0:2"|`mapped0e:mapped1e:mapped2e`=="0:0:3") )%>% droplevels()

#select guides for selected transcripts (3 for coding region and 2 for each utrs)

selected_mRNA_guides<- all_mRNA_data %>% filter(Transcript_ID %in% final_selected_transcript_data$Transcript_ID) %>% droplevels()
length(unique(selected_mRNA_guides$Transcript_ID))


selected_mRNA_guides<- selected_mRNA_guides%>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID, Region) %>% mutate(order = rank(- standardizedGuideScores, ties.method = "first"))

selected_mRNA_guides<- selected_mRNA_guides%>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID, Region) %>% mutate(distance_to_top_guide = abs(MatchPos - MatchPos[order==1])) %>% ungroup()

selected_mRNA_guides<- selected_mRNA_guides%>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID, Region) %>% mutate(max_distance=max(distance_to_top_guide))

selected_mRNA_guides<- selected_mRNA_guides%>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID, Region) %>% mutate(select=case_when(
    max_distance< 25 ~ "yes",
    distance_to_top_guide==0|distance_to_top_guide >25 ~"yes",
  
  )) %>% ungroup()

  
selected_mRNA_guides%>% ggplot(aes(y=distance_to_top_guide, color=Region))+geom_boxplot()

set.seed(125)
UTR3_high_rank<- selected_mRNA_guides %>% filter(Region=="UTR3", order<21, select=="yes") %>% droplevels()%>% group_by(Transcript_ID) %>% slice_sample(n=2)
set.seed(125)
UTR5_high_rank<- selected_mRNA_guides%>% filter(Region=="UTR5", order<21, select=="yes") %>% droplevels()%>% group_by(Transcript_ID) %>% slice_sample(n=2)
UTRs<- rbind(UTR3_high_rank, UTR5_high_rank)
k<- as.data.frame(table(UTRs$Transcript_ID, UTRs$Region))
l<- k %>% group_by(Var1) %>% summarise(sum(Freq))
l<- l %>% dplyr::rename(number_of_grna=`sum(Freq)`)
m<- as.data.frame(setdiff(selected_mRNA_guides$Transcript_ID,l$Var1))
m$number_of_grna<- 0
names(m)<- c("Var1","number_of_grna")
n<- rbind(l,m)
CDS<- selected_mRNA_guides[0,0]
index<-c(0:4)
set.seed(125)


for(i in index){
Transcript_IDs <- n %>%
  filter(number_of_grna == i) %>%
  pull(Var1)

CDS<-rbind(CDS,( selected_mRNA_guides %>%
  filter(Transcript_ID %in% Transcript_IDs &
           Region == "CDS" &
           order < 21 &  
           select == "yes") %>%  
  droplevels() %>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID) %>%
  slice_sample(n = (7-i))))
}


all_new<- rbind(UTRs,CDS)

all_new<- left_join(all_new, (final_selected_transcript_data %>% dplyr::select(Transcript_ID, transcript_length, transcript_biotype, Gene, ensembl_gene_id)), by="Transcript_ID")

print(paste("we have", nrow(all_new), "gRNAs targeting", length(unique(all_new$Transcript_ID)),"/",length(unique(final_selected_transcript_data$Transcript_ID)), "transcripts of", length(unique(all_new$Gene)),"/", length(unique(final_gene_list$Gene)), "genes"))
```

##lets check if remaining transcripts has data in gencode.v19.Cas13d_crRNAs.txt file

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
remaining_transcripts<- all_gRNA_data %>% filter(Transcript_ID %in% final_selected_transcript_data$Transcript_ID & !(Transcript_ID %in% all_new$Transcript_ID )) %>% droplevels()

remaining_genes<- all_gRNA_data %>% filter((ensembl_gene_id %in% final_selected_transcript_data$ensembl_gene_id)) %>% filter(!(ensembl_gene_id %in% all_new$ensembl_gene_id )) %>% filter(!(ensembl_gene_id%in%remaining_transcripts$ensembl_gene_id)) %>% droplevels()
## I will add EML4 gene also because it is frequently fusion partner in lung cancer
remaining_genes_by_name<-all_gRNA_data %>%  filter((Symbol %in% final_selected_transcript_data$Gene)) %>% filter(!(Symbol %in% all_new$Gene)) %>% filter(!(Symbol%in%remaining_transcripts$Symbol)) %>% filter((Symbol %in% final_selected_transcript_data$Gene)) %>% filter(!(Symbol %in% all_new$Gene)) %>% filter(!(Symbol%in% remaining_genes$Symbol)) %>% droplevels()

eml4<- all_gRNA_data %>%  filter((Symbol =="EML4"))


intersect(remaining_genes$ensembl_gene_id,all_new$ensembl_gene_id)

remaining_data<- rbind(remaining_genes, remaining_transcripts, remaining_genes_by_name, eml4)

#pick the longest transcript of remaining genes
remaining_data <- remaining_data %>% group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% filter(Length==max(Length)) %>% droplevels()
set.seed(125)
rem_UTR3_high_rank<- remaining_data %>% filter(Region=="UTR3") %>% droplevels()%>% group_by(Transcript_ID) %>% slice_max(Guide_Score, n=2, with_ties=FALSE)
set.seed(125)
rem_UTR5_high_rank<- remaining_data %>% filter(Region=="UTR5")%>% droplevels()%>%group_by(Transcript_ID) %>% slice_max(Guide_Score, n=2, with_ties=FALSE)
rem_UTRs<- rbind(rem_UTR3_high_rank, rem_UTR5_high_rank)
k<- as.data.frame(table(rem_UTRs$Transcript_ID, rem_UTRs$Region))
l<- k %>% group_by(Var1) %>% summarise(sum(Freq))
l<- l %>% dplyr::rename(number_of_grna=`sum(Freq)`)
m<- as.data.frame(setdiff(remaining_data$Transcript_ID,l$Var1))
m$number_of_grna<- 0
names(m)<- c("Var1","number_of_grna")
n<- rbind(l,m)

rem_CDS<- remaining_data[0,0]
index<-c(0:4)
set.seed(125)
for(i in index){
Transcript_IDs <- n %>%
  filter(number_of_grna == i) %>%
  pull(Var1)

rem_CDS<-rbind(rem_CDS,( remaining_data %>%
  filter(Transcript_ID %in% Transcript_IDs &
           Region == "CDS" ) %>% 
  droplevels() %>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID) %>%
  slice_sample(n = (7-i))))
}

rem_gRNA<- rbind(rem_UTRs, rem_CDS)

names(all_new)
names(rem_gRNA)

all_new_selected<- all_new%>% dplyr::select(Transcript_ID, ensembl_gene_id, Gene, Region, GuideName, GuideSeq, MatchPos, GuideScores) 
all_new_selected$GuideScores<- as.numeric(as.character(all_new_selected$GuideScores))

rem_gRNA_selected<- rem_gRNA %>% dplyr::select(Transcript_ID, ensembl_gene_id, Gene=Symbol, Region, GuideName=cRNA_name, GuideSeq=Seq, MatchPos=start, GuideScores=Guide_Score)
rem_gRNA_selected$GuideScores<- as.numeric(as.character(rem_gRNA_selected$GuideScores))

all_mRNA_gRNA_selection<- rbind(all_new_selected, rem_gRNA_selected)

print(paste("we have", nrow(all_mRNA_gRNA_selection), "gRNAs targeting", length(unique(all_mRNA_gRNA_selection$Transcript_ID)),"/",length(unique(final_selected_transcript_data$Transcript_ID)), "transcripts of", length(unique(all_mRNA_gRNA_selection$Gene)),"/", length(unique(final_gene_list$Gene)), "genes"))

number_of_gRNA_per_transcript<- as.data.frame(table(all_mRNA_gRNA_selection$Transcript_ID))
number_of_gRNA_per_transcript %>% ggplot(aes(x=Freq))+geom_bar()+xlab("number of gRNA per transcript")

all_mRNA_gRNA_selection %>% ggplot(aes(y=GuideScores,x=Region ))+geom_boxplot()


```



#Designing gRNA for 122 noncoding genes implicated in cancer
from paper https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/152769v3.supplementary-material
also published in Now published in Communications Biology doi: 10.1038/s42003-019-0741-7
downloaded designed noncoding RNAs from https://cas13design.nygenome.org/
```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
selected_lncRNA_transcripts<- read_csv(here(file = "sym_101_design/output/selected_lncRNA_transcripts_2025-05-07.csv"))

length(setdiff( selected_lncRNA_transcripts_old$Transcript_ID,selected_lncRNA_transcripts$Transcript_ID))


nc_genes<- readxl::read_xlsx(path = here("sym_101_design/input/CLC_non_coding_cancer_genes.xlsx"), col_names = T, sheet = 2)
```


```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library(readr)
# we have gnra design file for each lncrna transcript, we will combine them in a single data frame

add_transcript_id_column <- function(file_path) {
  df <- read_csv(file_path)
  df$Transcript_ID <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  return(df)
}


source_directory <- here("sym_101_design/input/human_non_coding_gRNAs/combined")

# List CSV files in the source directory
file_list <- fs::dir_ls(source_directory, regexp = "\\.csv$", ignore.case = TRUE)

# Create an empty list to store data frames
dfs_list <- list()

# Read each CSV file, add "Transcript_ID" column, and store in the list
for (file_path in file_list) {
  df <- add_transcript_id_column(file_path)
  dfs_list <- append(dfs_list, list(df))
}

# Combine all csv files into a single data frame
combined_df <- bind_rows(dfs_list)

combined_df<- combined_df %>% separate(Transcript_ID, into = c("Transcript_ID", "X")) %>% dplyr::select(!X)

### get data for all transcripts


library(biomaRt)

ensembl=useEnsembl(biomart="genes",dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version=110)   # dataset and database chosen.

transcript_data_all_gRNAs = getBM(attributes = c('external_gene_name','ensembl_transcript_id','transcript_length','ensembl_gene_id',"transcript_biotype" ),filters = 'ensembl_transcript_id', values = combined_df$Transcript_ID, mart = ensembl)
transcript_data_all_gRNAs <- transcript_data_all_gRNAs  %>% dplyr::rename(Gene=external_gene_name, Transcript_ID=ensembl_transcript_id)
length(unique(transcript_data_all_gRNAs$Transcript_ID))

transcript_data_all_gRNAs <- transcript_data_all_gRNAs %>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID) %>%
  mutate(count = n()) %>% ungroup()

transcript_data_all_gRNAs<- unique(transcript_data_all_gRNAs)
combined_df<- left_join(combined_df, transcript_data_all_gRNAs, by="Transcript_ID")
levels(as.factor(combined_df$transcript_biotype))

print(paste("There are gRNAs designed for only",length(unique(combined_df$Transcript_ID)),"noncoding RNA transripts corresponding to", length(unique(combined_df$ensembl_gene_id)), "genes"))


```


```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
#first filter gRNAs for our selected transcripts
lncRNA_gRNAs<- combined_df %>% filter(Transcript_ID %in% selected_lncRNA_transcripts$Transcript_ID) %>% droplevels()

sum(is.na(lncRNA_gRNAs$ensembl_gene_id))
print(paste("I picked all gRNAs targeting",length(unique(lncRNA_gRNAs$Transcript_ID)), "transcripts of", length(unique(lncRNA_gRNAs$ensembl_gene_id)), "genes."))

# select all gRNAs for other genes in the list then pick the gRNAs targeting the longest transcript

all_gRNAs_for_nontargeted_genes<- combined_df %>% filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% (setdiff(selected_lncRNA_transcripts$ensembl_gene_id, lncRNA_gRNAs$ensembl_gene_id))) %>% droplevels()

gRNAs_for_nontargeted_genes <- all_gRNAs_for_nontargeted_genes %>%
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  filter(transcript_length == max(transcript_length)) %>%
  ungroup()
names(lncRNA_gRNAs)

##combine all gRNAs together

lncRNA_gRNAs_all<- rbind(lncRNA_gRNAs, gRNAs_for_nontargeted_genes)
lncRNA_gRNAs_all<- left_join(lncRNA_gRNAs_all, (selected_lncRNA_transcripts %>% dplyr::select(Transcript_ID, selection_criteria)), by="Transcript_ID")

print(paste("in the final list we have gRNAs for", length(unique(lncRNA_gRNAs_all$Transcript_ID)),"transcripts targeting",length(unique(lncRNA_gRNAs_all$ensembl_gene_id)), "out of", nrow(nc_genes),"cancer related lncRNA genes"))



```




## next pick gRNAs along the gene body
```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
lncRNA_gRNAs_final <-lncRNA_gRNAs_all %>% filter(`mapped0e:mapped1e:mapped2e`=="0:0:0"& quartiles%in%c(4)) %>%  group_by(Transcript_ID) %>%  mutate(percentage = (MatchPos/ max(MatchPos)) * 100) %>%
  mutate(percentage_bin = cut(percentage, breaks = seq(0, 100, by=20), labels = c("0-20%", "21-40%" ,"41-60%", "61-80%", "81-100%"), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>% group_by(Transcript_ID, percentage_bin) %>%  mutate(bin = ntile(MatchPos, 2)) %>%
  group_by(Transcript_ID,percentage_bin, bin) %>%
  slice_max(standardizedGuideScores, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()


print(paste("in the final list of lcnRNA targeting guides we have", nrow(lncRNA_gRNAs_final), "guides targeting", length(unique(lncRNA_gRNAs_final$Transcript_ID)), "transcripts for",length(unique(lncRNA_gRNAs_final$ensembl_gene_id)), "out of", nrow(nc_genes), "lcnRNA genes"))

```

#adding control guides
I copied control guides from Sanjana Lab gitlab repository 
https://gitlab.com/sanjanalab/cas13/-/blob/master/TilingScreens/data/CD46_library_final.fa?ref_type=heads
```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
# Load the required packages
library(Biostrings)

fasta_path <- "sym_101_design/input/control_guides.fa"


# Read the FASTA file
sequences <- readDNAStringSet(fasta_path)

# Extract names and sequences
sequence_names <- names(sequences)
sequence_strings <- as.character(sequences)

# Create a data frame
control_guides <- data.frame(GuideName = sequence_names, GuideSeq = sequence_strings, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
str_length(control_guides[2,2])
set.seed(125)
selected_100_control<-control_guides %>% sample_n(100)

str_length(sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs$GuideSeq[3])

sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control<- bind_rows(sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs, selected_100_control)

sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control<- sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>% mutate(Gene=case_when(
  is.na(Gene)~ "NT_Control",
  TRUE ~ Gene),
  transcript_biotype=case_when(
  is.na(transcript_biotype)~ "NT_Control",
  TRUE ~ transcript_biotype),
  Transcript_ID=case_when(
  is.na(Transcript_ID)~ GuideName,
  TRUE ~ Transcript_ID))


write_csv(sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control, file="sym_101_design/output/syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control_new.csv")

previous<-read_csv( file="sym_101_design/output/syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control_new.csv")
(setdiff(old_data$Transcript_ID,sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$Transcript_ID ))

b<- sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>% filter(Transcript_ID %in% setdiff(sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$Transcript_ID, old_data$Transcript_ID))

setdiff(old_data$Transcript_ID, sym_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control$Transcript_ID)

  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), vjust = -0.5, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Tanscript Biotype \nSymp_101 library",
       x = "Transcript Biotypes",
       y = "Number of Transcripts")+theme_bw()+theme(legend.position = "none")


```

#Oligo order design


```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
## check repeated gRNAs
a<- syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>% 
group_by(GuideSeq) %>%
  mutate(is_repeated = n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
print(paste(sum(a$is_repeated==TRUE),"gRNAs are targeting multiple transcripts of the same gene. I'll leave them as they are)"))

selected_gRNAs<- syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(GuideName, GuideSeq) 
selected_gRNAs<-selected_gRNAs %>% distinct(GuideSeq, .keep_all = TRUE)
selected_gRNAs$left_oligo<- c("cccctaccaactggtcggggtttgaaac")
selected_gRNAs$right_oligo<-c("tttttGgGATCCAATTCTACCGGGTAGGG")
selected_gRNAs$right_oligo<-tolower(selected_gRNAs$right_oligo)
selected_gRNAs$gibson_oligo<-paste(selected_gRNAs$left_oligo, selected_gRNAs$GuideSeq, selected_gRNAs$right_oligo, sep = "")
str_length(selected_gRNAs$gibson_oligo[1])
selected_gRNAs$library_amp_primer_reverse<- c("CGTCTGAGCTGTCATGGTCG")
selected_gRNAs$library_amp_primer_forward<- c("GACGTCCAGAGCACAGATGG")
selected_gRNAs$final_oligo<-paste(selected_gRNAs$library_amp_primer_forward, selected_gRNAs$gibson_oligo, selected_gRNAs$library_amp_primer_reverse, sep = "")
print(paste("the length of gRNAs is", str_length(selected_gRNAs$GuideSeq[1]),"bp, gibson framgemt is",str_length(selected_gRNAs$gibson_oligo[1]),"bp and final oligo is", str_length(selected_gRNAs$final_oligo[1]),"bp."))

write_csv(selected_gRNAs, file="output/symp_101_final_oligo_design.csv")
print(selected_gRNAs$final_oligo[5])
```

convert to fasta file
```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library(Biostrings)
# Convert sequences to XStringSet
sequences <- DNAStringSet(selected_gRNAs$final_oligo)

# Set the names of the XStringSet to be the headers
names(sequences) <- selected_gRNAs$GuideName

# Define the output FASTA file
fasta_file <- "output/symp_101_final_oligo_pool.fasta"

# Write XStringSet to FASTA file
writeXStringSet(sequences, fasta_file)
```
